_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Nde Player {player_id} Tic Tac Toe-pe.
Ne remiño ha'e oipysyrõ mbohapy peteĩ rupa (yvatépe, ykére, térã diagonalménte) tablero-pe.
Nde ñe'ẽme, eiporavo va'erã kuatiarogue (0-8) nde reha'ãrõha.
Techapyrã, '[4]' omoĩ nde reha'ã tablero ryepype.
Nde Player {player_id}-ramo, nde reha'ã ha'e '{symbol}', nde rekovia ha'e '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ko movimiento oñemog̃uahẽva noñemoañetéi formato hekopete.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ndaha'éi peteĩ celda válida. Oimeva'erã 0 ha 8 apytépe.
